title: Assistant Manager- Outside Sales
description:
**Overview**

**IMI plc**

  

We are a global specialist engineering company that creates breakthrough solutions. We are curious and like to solve problems, partnering with our customers to solve the demands of today and prepare for the challenges of tomorrow. We embrace innovation and care about outcomes that are good for business, everyday life and making a better world — creating lasting impact for everyone.

We design, build and service highly engineered products in fluid and motion control applications. We focus on five market sectors: Industrial Automation, Process Automation, Climate Control, Life Science and Fluid Control,

and Transport.

  

We employ approximately 10,000 people in over 50 countries around the world, find out more about lMl plc here

  

**Key Accountabilities**

* Responsible for managing the assigned territory for India Aftermarket Controls business in full alignment with IMI CCI policies.
* Maintain strong customer relationships with all plants in the designated area.
* Conduct regular plant visits to support outage planning, improve plant performance, reduce downtime, and promote IMI CCI aftermarket solutions.
* Build and maintain long‑term relationships with plant owners/operators to secure ongoing business and future sales references.
* Plan and manage sales activities by ensuring accurate, up‑to‑date information in the CRM (SFDC).
* Stay informed about global and local market trends, upcoming projects, and relevant industry events within the assigned territory.

  

**Sales**

* Maintain and regularly update all commercial activities in the IMI CCI CRM as per management requirements.
* Stay informed on customer tender portals/sources and record them in CRM.
* Coordinate with inside sales to obtain and submit budgetary proposals for customer outages.
* Receive RFQs, translate/clarify, and forward them to inside sales promptly.
* Review proposals from inside sales and submit them to customers quickly, preferably in person.
* Actively follow up on submitted proposals.
* Forward customer purchase orders to inside sales immediately and assist with translations/clarifications.
* Support communication between inside sales/project management and customers to avoid shipment or payment issues.
* Assist finance with overdue cash collection when required.
* Promote IMI and IMI CCI Aftermarket functions during customer interactions.
* Attend IMI CCI meetings/conferences and contribute to overall business profitability.
* Collaborate with IMI CCI sales teams (Marketing, Nuclear, Upgrades, Follow-On) in IMI’s best interest.
* Work with Application Engineering and Technical Services to ensure optimal customer support.

  

**Plant Visits**

* Plan and conduct plant visits ahead of outages to promote IMI CCI aftermarket products and solutions and record all visits in the CRM.
* During visits, perform walk‑downs to inspect installed valves/controllers, take inspection notes, and update them in the CRM.
* Check warehouse inventories during plant visits and inform customers of replenishment needs.
* Carry appropriate and approved PPE to customer sites to safely perform inspections and inventory checks.

  

**Outage Management**

* Maintain and update planned outages at plants/units in the IMI CCI CRM tool.
* Being aware of the sources for information on plant outages and staying updated on this information, as well as reflecting it in the IMI CCI CRM tool.

  

**Forecasting**

  

* Keep the IMI CRM continuously updated with opportunities, outages, sales visits, OVC data, and other required inputs to ensure accurate forecasting.
* Prepare 5‑year sales forecasts for all active plants in the assigned territory within the CRM.
* Provide ongoing forecasts as required by management through the CRM and supply short‑term outage, OVC, and opportunity forecasts in other formats when requested.

  

**Desired skills and experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in mechanical/chemical/Instrumentation Engineering with 6-10 years in handling technical sales experience, preferably control valves, actuators, pumps, compressors, or other mechanically related equipment, preferably control valves or other mechanically related equipment.
* General working knowledge of Power Plants, Fertiliser, Oil & Gas production / processing facilities is preferable.
* Good understanding of commercial terms used in industry and knowledge of Sales Process including tender/enquiry process.
* Excellent time management and interpersonal skills essential.
* Excellent communications skills, both verbal and written required, in English & local language if any.

  

IMI is an inclusive employer; diversity is very important to us, and we want to receive applications from people from all backgrounds

title: Mainframe Modernization Architect
description:
At Ensono, our **Purpose is to be a relentless ally, disrupting the status quo and unleashing our clients to Do Great Things*****!*** We enable our clients to achieve key business outcomes that reshape how our world runs. As an expert technology adviser and managed service provider with cross-platform certifications, Ensono empowers our clients to keep up with continuous change and embrace innovation.

We can **Do Great Things** because we have great Associates. The Ensono Core Values unify our diverse talents and are woven into how we do business. These five traits are the key to achieving our purpose:

Honesty, Reliability, Curiosity, Collaboration, and Passion.

**About the role and what you’ll be doing:**

* Collaborate with their counterparts in the Sales and Consulting organizations to create Pursuit, Solution, and Sales strategies for large existing global clients
* Conduct discovery and assessment workshops (often in collaboration with resources from consulting, operations and product teams) to help drive further penetration of the client account
* Develop and document solutions that meet client’s (technical and business) requirements and allow them to adapt to changing industry needs with a focus on transformation and re-platform efforts
* Conduct solution development sessions and present technical solutions and business cases to a wide variety of audience
* Gain executives buy in for complex solutions by engaging in executive and senior-level technology discussions
* Gain clients’ confidence as a trusted advisor by offering consultation and recommendations drawing from technology know-how and past experiences
* Align and partner with Product Management to help drive appropriate product enhancements and changes to technology roadmap
* Aid in driving stability and innovation within the client’s current and future state and create solutions based on client requirements and available product offerings

  

**We want all new Associates to succeed in their roles at Ensono. That’s why we’ve outlined the job requirements below. To be considered for this role, it’s important that you meet all Required Qualifications. If you do not meet all of the Preferred Qualifications, we still encourage you to apply.**

### **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or computer sciences
* 20+ years of experience as an architect or equivalent in the hosting and network space (preferably with a service provider)
* Over 12 years’ experience as a Modernization or Migration Architect, leading legacy system upgrades to new platforms with minimal business disruption.
* Hands-on experience with Mainframe Application migration and legacy modernization projects.
* 15+ years of experience with strong expertise across the mainframe technology stack, including COBOL, Natural, Adabas, Easytrieve, Db2, IMS, JCL, CICS, VSAM, RACF, z/OS, PL/I, and Assembler.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Proven experience in managing projects through the entire project lifecycle. This includes managing multi-phase/multi-dimensional/multi-resource projects to conclusion while maintaining high client satisfaction
* Demonstrated expertise in data migration, with a strong emphasis on understanding and working with legacy data structures to effectively convert and modernize them into modern database platforms.
* Skilled in evaluating mainframe legacy applications and developing comprehensive modernization plans.
* Demonstrated development experience with modern Java and C# frameworks, including designing and implementing scalable enterprise applications.
* Additionally, has extensive experience working with Python, applying the language for scripting, automation, data analysis, and developing scalable backend systems that facilitate enterprise modernization efforts.
* Understanding of (and experience with) public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure) and hybrid solutions preferred
* Demonstrated ability to understand and leverage Artificial Intelligence, applying AI-driven strategies and tools to modernize legacy systems and enhance data migration efforts.
* Skilled in identifying use cases for AI within legacy modernization practices, driving innovation by integrating intelligent automation, advanced analytics, and machine learning solutions to streamline processes and create future-ready technologically
* Well versed in the hosting technology landscape including compute, storage, backup, network, security, DR, DevOps and IT governance
* Good understanding of the sales process for large and complex opportunities.
* Resourceful and confident in Crisis and Expectation management and confident under pressure
* Has experience in technical documentation to capture solution components in a timely manner while ensuring acceptable level of detail, data integrity, and accountability
* Ability to share knowledge and expertise among various organizations within the company and to facilitate teamwork among those organizations to better serve our clients
* Ability to work in a team environment and demonstrate strong problem-solving skills
* Proficient with common office applications such as MS Outlook, MS Excel, PowerPoint and MS Visio
* Excellent organizational, interpersonal, and communication skills (oral, written and presentation)
  

**Shift Timings:** 1:30 PM to 10:30 PM IST

We are an equal opportunity employer. title: Production & Supplier Follow-up Executive
description:
Job Description: Production & Supplier Follow-up Executive (Textile Machinery Manufacturing)

**Department:** Production Planning & Control (PPC) / Materials  
**Reports to:** PPC Manager / Production Manager  
**Coordinates with:** Purchase, Stores, Machining, Fabrication, Assembly, Quality, Subcontract Vendors, Sales/Dispatch

1. Job Purpose

The Production & Supplier Follow-up Executive makes sure that sub contract items are received as planned. This role tracks production progress on the shop floor and follows up with suppliers and job-work vendors so that castings, machined parts, bought-out items, and processed components arrive on time and to the right quality. The aim is to remove bottlenecks early, prevent assembly delays, and meet customer delivery commitments.

2. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Production Follow-up

* Track daily production against the monthly and weekly plan for machining, fabrication, painting, sub-assembly, and final assembly of textile machines.
* Monitor work order status and work-in-progress (WIP) at each stage, and highlight jobs that are falling behind schedule.
* Prepare and update shortage lists for each machine or order by comparing the BOM with available stock and pending supplies.
* Attend daily production review meetings, share status updates, and follow up on actions agreed.
* Coordinate between Stores, Machining, and Assembly so components and kits reach the line on time.
* Follow up on internal rework, rejections, and quality holds so they are cleared quickly.
* Track machine readiness for testing, trial runs, inspection, and dispatch, and update Sales on expected dispatch dates.
* Escalate bottlenecks such as machine breakdowns, manpower gaps, or material shortages to the Production Manager with possible solutions.

B. Supplier Follow-up (Bought-out Items)

* Get acknowledgment of Purchase Orders from suppliers and confirm committed delivery dates.
* Follow up regularly with suppliers of castings, forgings, bearings, gears, motors, drives, electrical panels, sheet metal parts, and fasteners as per delivery schedules.
* Expedite urgent and critical items based on production priorities, and keep Purchase and PPC informed of any delay in advance.
* Track open POs and maintain a pending delivery report with expected arrival dates.
* Visit supplier premises when required to check progress, resolve issues, or speed up deliveries.
* Coordinate with Quality on supplier rejections and follow up for replacement or rework.
* Make sure suppliers send correct documents such as invoices, test certificates, and inspection reports along with the material.

C. Job Work / Subcontract Vendor Follow-up

* Follow up with job-work vendors for machining, heat treatment, grinding, plating, powder coating, and painting.
* Track materials sent on returnable delivery challans and make sure they come back on time and in the right quantity.
* Share drawings, process requirements, and priorities with vendors clearly to avoid mistakes and delays.
* Reconcile material balance with vendors and report pending items to Stores and Accounts.

D. Vendor Performance & Development

* Maintain records of on-time delivery and quality performance for each supplier and job-work vendor.
* Support the monthly or quarterly vendor rating process.
* Identify repeated delays or quality issues and recommend corrective action or alternate vendors to Purchase.
* Support new vendor development by sharing requirements and tracking sample or first-lot approvals.

E. Planning Support

* Support the PPC team in preparing material requirement plans (MRP) based on the order book and production plan.

**Job Title:** Customer Relationship Executive (Professional Day\-Maker \& Problem Solver)  
**Are you the person your friends call when they need to complain, negotiate a refund, or figure out a complicated situation?**  
Most companies call this a "Customer Service" role. We call it the heartbeat of our business. At **\[BIG SECURITY NETWORKS]**, we are looking for a Customer Relationship Executive who has the patience of a kindergarten teacher, the empathy of a therapist, and the problem\-solving skills of an escape room champion.  
If you are tired of reading boring job descriptions with corporate buzzwords like "synergy" and "fast\-paced environment," keep reading. We promise not to tell you "we're a family here" (we're a team, and you don't get to choose your family, but you do get to choose where you work).

description:
**Job Title \- Nutrition Officer/ Executive**

**Function \- Infant Nutrition**

**Location \- Anantapur**

 **About the role**


This is a field role focused on ethical engagement with Health Care Professionals (HCPs) to share scientific, evidence‑based information on infant nutrition and Nestlé’s Infant Nutrition portfolio. The role requires clear and compliant communication of product features, advantages and benefits, and their appropriate use—strictly within Nestlé’s Code of Ethics, company instructions, and the Indian Code. The role consistently upholds the principle that mother’s milk is best for babies.

 **Job Description (Key Responsibilities)**

* Ethically promote Nestlé’s Infant Nutrition products to HCPs by clearly communicating product features, advantages, benefits and appropriate use, in line with company Code of Ethics and the Indian Code; reinforce that mother’s milk is best for babies.
* Ensure recommendations for the Nestlé Nutrition product range remain within the scope of the Indian Code; detail against homemade paps and bovine milk as appropriate.
* Serve as a reliable source of information on infant nutrition and infant feeding practices for HCPs.
* Plan and execute high‑quality scientific detailing, CMEs/symposiums and other scientific activities as per company guidelines.
* Map and segment HCPs in the assigned territory; develop and execute an effective coverage plan and call cycle.
* Maintain accurate records of HCP interactions, feedback, and scientific events; provide timely reports as per guidance.
* Identify opportunities and potential within the territory and contribute inputs to drive demand generation activities within compliance.
* Collaborate with internal teams to ensure availability of compliant scientific materials and support tools for field execution.

 **Qualifications**

* Graduate with at least 1 year of experience in a field sales role in either a Nutrition company or the pharmaceutical industry.
* High level of integrity and honesty; hardworking, self‑motivated, and passionate about enhancing quality of life and contributing to a healthier future.
* Ability to work effectively in a team and build strong, sustainable relationships with stakeholders.
* High learning agility; trustworthy and able to work independently within company policies and guidelines.

 **About Us**

title: AI Transformation Consultant – Pre-Sales & Discovery
description:
The AI Transformation Consultant will lead executive workshops, operational discovery and AI assessments forprospective and existing clients. The consultant’s responsibility is not to sell AI tools indiscriminately. It is tounderstand how the client operates, identify high\-value problems and convert those findings into a prioritizedtransformation roadmap and credible business case.

This is a senior, client\-facing consulting and pre\-sales position. The successful candidate will be equally comfortableinterviewing a business owner, mapping an operational workflow, quantifying an opportunity and presentingrecommendations to senior decision\-makers.

Key responsibilities

Executive workshops

Conduct structured AI opportunity workshops for U.S. SMB owners and leadership teams.

Educate clients on practical applications of AI, automation, knowledge systems and process redesign.

Help clients distinguish valuable business use cases from low\-value experimentation.

Facilitate discussions across business owners, functional leaders and operational users.

Adapt workshop examples to different industries without relying on generic AI demonstrations.

Discovery and process diagnosis

Conduct structured interviews with executives, department heads and process owners.

Understand the client’s business model, workflows, systems, constraints and growth objectives.

Identify bottlenecks, repetitive activities, information gaps, decision delays and customer experience issues.

Document current\-state processes and define the business outcomes expected from improvement.

Separate problems requiring process redesign from those that genuinely benefit from automation or AI.

AI opportunity assessment

Produce prioritized AI transformation assessments covering approximately three to seven opportunities.

Score opportunities based on business value, implementation feasibility, risk, data readiness and time toimpact.

Develop current\-state and future\-state process maps with support from the AI Solutions Consultant.

Estimate potential time savings, cost reduction, capacity creation, revenue impact and customer experienceimprovements.

Create a phased roadmap that distinguishes quick wins from longer\-term transformation initiatives.

Commercial conversion

Present assessment findings to client decision\-makers in a persuasive, evidence\-based format.

Connect recommendations to the client’s financial and strategic priorities.

Position Vserve implementation services as the natural next step without compromising the independence ofthe assessment.

Work with sales leadership to shape implementation offers, pricing and proposals.

Support approximately five to eight completed assessments per month.

Maintain disciplined follow\-up until the opportunity is converted, deferred or closed.

Internal capability development

Build reusable discovery questionnaires, workshop modules, assessment frameworks and industry\-specificuse\-case libraries.

Capture recurring client problems and convert them into repeatable Vserve service offerings.

Train business development and account management teams to recognize qualified AI transformationopportunities.

Improve the assessment methodology based on implementation results and client feedback.

Expected deliverables

For each qualified client engagement:

Executive AI opportunity workshop

Stakeholder interview notes and discovery transcript

Current\-state process analysis

Prioritized AI and process\-improvement opportunity matrix

High\-level future\-state workflows

Indicative ROI and business case

Ninety\-day action plan and longer\-term roadmap

Executive assessment presentation

Implementation opportunity brief for the Vserve delivery team

Required experience and capabilities

Eight or more years in management consulting, business transformation, process excellence, enterprise pre\-sales, digital transformation or a comparable client\-facing role.

Strong experience interviewing senior executives and operational stakeholders.

Demonstrated ability to understand unfamiliar businesses quickly.

Excellent process analysis, problem structuring and facilitation skills.

Ability to translate operational problems into quantified business cases.

Strong executive communication, presentation and consultative\-selling skills.

Working knowledge of generative AI, workflow automation, knowledge systems and modern SaaS platforms.

Ability to use AI tools productively for research, analysis, synthesis and deliverable creation.

Experience serving U.S. clients and communicating within a U.S. business context.

Excellent spoken and written English.

Preferred background

Candidates may come from:

Management or technology consulting

Digital transformation advisory

Process excellence or business process management

SaaS or automation pre\-sales

Business analysis with senior client\-facing responsibility

Intelligent automation or AI consulting

Experience in one or more SMB\-intensive sectors—professional services, distribution, e\-commerce, retail, healthcareadministration, real estate, logistics or financial services—is advantageous.

What this role is not

A lead\-generation or cold\-calling role

A generic account executive position

A data scientist or software development position

A product demonstration role centered on a single platform

A “prompt engineer” position

Success measures

Five to eight high\-quality assessments completed monthly by the pod

Percentage of workshops progressing to formal assessments

Percentage of assessments converting into paid implementation engagements

Qualified implementation pipeline created

Average projected and realized client value

Assessment turnaround time and client satisfaction

Reusability and quality of the methodologies developed

Accuracy of discovery findings compared with implementation\-stage findings

 **About Swiggy:**

  

Swiggy is India’s leading on\-deamand delivery platform with a tech\-first approach to logistics and a solution\-first approach to consumer demands. With a presence in 500\+ cities across India, partnerships with hundreds of thousands of restaurants, an employee base of over 5000, a 2 lakh\+ strong independent fleet of Delivery Executives, we deliver unparalleled convenience driven by continuous innovation. Built on the back of robust ML technology and fuelled by terabytes of data processed every day, Swiggy offers a fast, seamless and reliable delivery experience for millions of customers across India. From starting out as a hyperlocal food delivery service in 2014, to becoming India’s leading on\-demand convenience platform today, our capabilities result not only in lightning\-fast delivery for customers, but also in a productive and fulfilling experience for our employees.

 **Overview**

  

A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single\-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants—learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative \& On\-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners' success. You'll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.

* Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners

* Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy’s products as solutions, not features
* Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
* Data\-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants aren't growing, troubleshoot issues, and course\-correct
* Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
* Excel mastery: all the data related to your day\-to\-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
* Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
* 80 to 90 In\-person meetings with restaurant partners a month

* Comfort with data, especially Excel—you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
